scope.profile: Generated C repair profile through the real scripted ACP harness
scope.coverage: The declared source-file test writes exactly 4096 UTF-8 bytes containing multibyte text, then attempts a 4097-byte replacement whose character count remains below the 4096-byte ceiling. The ACP fixture requires the refusal and immediately reads back the original accepted candidate. The injected strict validator checks the exact bytes and digest; receipt/assessment checks correlate the change and require the accepted source and graph head to remain unchanged after the sentinel rejection. The shared retry fixture also remains covered for patch-byte and filesystem-write ceilings.
